prompts.title: Plan a faceless YouTube channel budget
prompts.summary: A tool list, budget and 6-month timeline for your channel
prompts.reel_title: Faceless YouTube: real costs and timelines
prompts.prompt: Act as a faceless YouTube planner. My channel topic is [topic], my monthly budget is [budget] and I have [hours per week] to work on it. List free or low-cost tools for scripting, voiceover, footage and editing, then a 6-month posting timeline. Explain the current YouTube monetization requirements. Say when you are not sure of a fee or rule.
then: Turn month 1 into a list of 8 video ideas with working titles.
prompts.tip: Check YouTube's own monetization page, because rules and tool fees change.

prompts.title: Turn 1 idea into 10 posts
prompts.summary: 10 post ideas, each with a hook, 3 points and a CTA
prompts.reel_title: Turn one idea into 10 posts with one AI prompt
prompts.prompt: Turn this idea: [your idea] into 10 Instagram posts for [your audience]. Give each one a hook, 3 points and a CTA.
then: Use 10 different angles, like a myth to bust, a quick checklist, a common mistake, a how-to, a short story and a before and after. Then write #1 as a 30-second reel script.
prompts.tip: Post one a day and one idea becomes 10 days of content.

prompts.title: Find your side hustle in 60 seconds
prompts.summary: 5 side hustles ranked by the fastest path to a first $100
prompts.reel_title: Copy this before you pick another side hustle
prompts.prompt: I have [hours a week], [budget] to start, and I'm good at [skill]. Give me 5 side hustles I can start this week, ranked by the fastest path to a first $100. For each: the first 3 steps and the free tools to use.
prompts.tip: Add your country at the end so it only suggests platforms that pay where you live.

prompts.title: Passive income reality check
prompts.summary: The honest hours, costs and timeline before you start
prompts.reel_title: 'Passive income' is a lie (here's what it really means)
prompts.prompt: I'm thinking about [passive income idea]. Give me the honest version: how many hours of work before it earns anything, the upfront costs, how long a first sale usually takes, what keeps it running, and the 3 most common reasons people quit. End with one small test I can run this week before I commit.
then: Turn that test into a checklist I can finish in 3 evenings.
prompts.tip: If the AI gives you numbers, ask where they come from. Treat them as rough guesses.

prompts.title: Cut any script into a 30-second reel
prompts.summary: A 2-second hook, on-screen text and b-roll for every line
prompts.prompt: Here's my video script: [paste your script]. Cut it into a 30-second reel. Start with a hook that works in the first 2 seconds, keep one idea per line, give on-screen text for each line (max 6 words) and a b-roll idea for each line, and end with a line that makes people want to rewatch.

examples.paste your script: Most people quit YouTube after 10 videos. The ones who make it pick one topic, post on a schedule, and study their best video every month.

then: Give me 5 other hooks for the same reel, each under 10 words.
prompts.tip: Read the hook out loud. If it takes more than 2 seconds to say, cut it.

prompts.title: Pick where to sell your product
prompts.summary: Gumroad vs Etsy vs Payhip for your exact product
prompts.reel_title: Where to sell digital products (Gumroad, Etsy, Payhip)
prompts.prompt: I want to sell [product] to [buyer]. Compare Gumroad, Etsy and Payhip for my case: who already shops there, fees, how buyers would find me, and setup time. If you're not sure about a current fee, say so and tell me where to check. Then pick one and write my first listing title and 5 tags.
then: What should I do in my first 14 days on that platform?
prompts.tip: Fees change. Check each platform's pricing page before you decide.

prompts.title: Is your Notion template worth selling?
prompts.summary: An honest demand check, a page plan and a price range
prompts.reel_title: Selling Notion templates: the honest breakdown
prompts.prompt: I want to sell a Notion template for [use]. Be honest: who would pay for this, which free templates already do the same, and what would make mine worth paying for. Then list the pages and databases it needs, and suggest a price range with your reasoning.
then: Write a 5-step setup guide a buyer could follow in 10 minutes.
prompts.tip: If the AI says free versions already do this well, pick a narrower buyer instead of giving up.

prompts.title: Ebook outline in 2 minutes
prompts.summary: A title, 7 chapters and an exercise for each one
prompts.reel_title: Make a full ebook outline with AI in 2 minutes
prompts.prompt: Outline a short ebook about [topic] for [reader]. Give me a title and subtitle, 7 chapters with 3 key points each, one quick exercise per chapter, and a one-sentence promise for the cover. Keep it practical, about 30 pages in total.
then: Write chapter 1 in simple words and short paragraphs, with one real-life example per point.
prompts.tip: Check every fact and number before you sell it. AI makes things up with confidence.

prompts.title: Your first paid offer
prompts.summary: A small service you can sell this week, and who to ask
prompts.reel_title: Why your first $100 online matters most
prompts.prompt: Help me turn [skill] into a small service I can sell this week for [price range]. Give me the offer in one sentence, who to offer it to, where to find them for free, a short message to send them, and exactly what I deliver. I'm a beginner with no portfolio, so keep it realistic.
then: Write 3 versions of that message: friendly, direct, and one for a business I already buy from.
prompts.tip: Send the message to 10 people before you change anything. Replies teach you more than planning.

prompts.title: Write your first Fiverr gig
prompts.summary: A title, description, 3 packages and FAQ answers
prompts.reel_title: AI voiceover freelancing: how it works
prompts.prompt: Write a Fiverr gig for [service] aimed at [client type]. Include a title under 80 characters, a description that opens with the client's problem, 3 packages (basic, standard, premium) with what's included and the delivery time, and answers to 5 common questions. If AI does part of the work, say so plainly in the description.
then: Suggest 5 search tags and a gig image idea that stands out in the results.
prompts.tip: Read Fiverr's rules on AI-made work, and check that your AI tool's license allows paid use.

prompts.title: Product description in 60 seconds
prompts.summary: A sales description plus 3 title options
prompts.reel_title: Use ChatGPT to write a product description in 60 seconds
prompts.prompt: Write a product description for [product] sold to [buyer]. Open with the problem it solves in one line, then 3 bullet points on benefits (not features), what's included, and a one-line call to buy. Plain words, under 120 words. Then give me 3 title options under 60 characters.
then: Now rewrite it for Etsy: a title that starts with the words buyers search for, plus 13 tags.
prompts.tip: Paste a competitor's description first and ask what yours should do better.

prompts.title: Check if an offer is a scam
prompts.summary: Red flags, a risk rating and how to verify it
prompts.reel_title: 3 'make money online' ads that are scams
prompts.prompt: Here is an offer I saw online: [paste the ad or message]. Check it for scam red flags: guaranteed income, upfront fees, pressure to act fast, a vague product, fake-looking reviews, or payment by gift card or crypto. Rate the risk low, medium or high, explain why in plain words, and tell me how to verify it before I pay anything.

examples.paste the ad or message: Earn $500 a day from your phone. No experience needed. Pay $49 to join, spots close tonight!

prompts.tip: Never pay to get a job, and never pay with gift cards. Real platforms don't ask for that.

prompts.title: Canva templates people pay for
prompts.summary: 10 template ideas for your niche, plus an Etsy listing
prompts.reel_title: How people sell Canva templates, step by step
prompts.prompt: Give me 10 Canva template ideas for [niche] that people would pay for. For each: who buys it, what problem it solves, and how many pages it needs. Mark the 3 fastest to make. Then write an Etsy title and description for the best one.
then: List exactly what goes on each page of that template.
prompts.tip: Search the idea on Etsy first. No sellers can mean no buyers; thousands means pick a smaller angle.

prompts.title: Make a prompt pack in a weekend
prompts.summary: 25 prompts in 5 sections, a name and a sales blurb
prompts.reel_title: How to make a prompt pack in one weekend
prompts.prompt: Help me make a prompt pack for [audience] who want to [goal]. Give me 25 prompts in 5 sections, each with one line on when to use it. Make every prompt specific to them, not generic. Then suggest a product name, a 3-line sales description and one bonus to include.
then: Run prompt #1 on a real example and show me the result, so I can judge if it's good enough to sell.
prompts.tip: Test every prompt yourself before you sell the pack. Cut the ones that give weak answers.
